You are the StageBench Phase 2 implementation agent for run gpt-6-luna (GPT-6 Luna Max).

Read WORKSPACE.md in this directory and follow it exactly.
Implement Phase 2 inside candidate/ only. Do not modify inputs/, prompts, specs, rubric, or anything outside candidate/.

When done:
1. Ensure pnpm test, pnpm typecheck, pnpm lint, and pnpm build all pass inside candidate/.
2. Put stage2-visual-audit.md under candidate/evidence/stage2-visual-audit.md (create evidence/ if needed). Leave screenshots for the operator seal step.
3. Report a brief summary + usage estimates; say DONE when the four gates pass.

Do not run pnpm bench seal yourself — the operator will seal after you finish.

Skip headless chrome/playwright approvals. Leave captures for seal. Finish four gates; put visual-audit under candidate/evidence/; include all hard-gate sentences verbatim in IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md; sampleSources need name/source/license per set. Say DONE.

Skip headless Chrome approvals. Leave stage2-desktop/narrow/capture for the operator seal.

Before DONE, ensure candidate/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md includes these hard-gate sentences VERBATIM (add any missing):
1. Grand, Upright, and Electric are bundled recorded sample sets that are audibly distinct, work offline, and have complete redistributable provenance.
2. Each effect unit and type processes real audio with working bypass and dry/wet.

Also keep the other Phase 2 hard gates already present. sampleSources must have name/source/license (you already look OK). Four gates must pass. Put stage2-visual-audit.md under candidate/evidence/ (already there). Say DONE.
